frozen_before: any v2 calibration rung is materialized (flt-cal-v2)
surfaces: materialization receipts' visible_metadata: what a participant can observe about each staged target without opening it, captured by the injector before any rollout starts; no outcome, trace, log, or timing evidence is a feature

decision_rule.statistic: balanced accuracy over sham and fault cells
decision_rule.null: seeded label permutation, same classifier and split
decision_rule.blocked_when: permutation p-value below alpha, or either class has fewer than minimum_cells_per_class cells

command: uv run harness fault leakage --report ~/aisle-private/fault-bank/v2/calibration-report.json --probe analysis/fault-bank/leakage-probe.json --output analysis/fault-bank/leakage-v2.json
note: v1 receipts carry no visible_metadata (the injector did not normalize or record it), so the probe cannot be run on flt-cal-v1 retroactively; it applies from the v2 candidate round on.
